title: Column and group counts change straight after a reassign
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create 4 work orders for the case customer, each Approved (Work Orders > New Work Order, add and approve a line): 3 with Lead Technician "Esther Howard" (e.g. S1-702, S1-698, S1-691) and 1 with "Ralph Edwards" (e.g. S1-687).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Read the count in Esther Howard's, Ralph Edwards' and Unassigned's column headers.
  4. Drag one of Esther Howard's cards (e.g. "S1-702") into Ralph Edwards' column.
  5. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  6. Read the three header counts again without reloading the page.
  7. Open Ralph Edwards' card "S1-687" More actions > Reassign lead technician, pick Unassigned and confirm.
  8. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  9. Read the three header counts again without reloading.
  10. Pick Tech View in the display switcher and read the three group header counts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the change the headers read Esther Howard 3, Ralph Edwards 1, Unassigned 0.
  • Straight after the drag, with no reload: Esther Howard 2 (3 − 1), Ralph Edwards 2 (1 + 1), Unassigned 0.
  • Straight after the dialog change: Ralph Edwards 1 (2 − 1), Unassigned 1 (0 + 1), Esther Howard still 2. Tech View shows the same three numbers in its group headers.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R7, read 8 Oct 2026. Header count definition S2-R12 / S3-R12 (work orders currently shown after filters). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
